name: John Smith
bio: John is a physical presence at flanker, known for his work rate at the breakdown. He joined the team as a walk-on sophomore and has started every match since.

name: Michael Brown
bio: Michael orchestrates the backline with composure beyond his years. A two-year captain and three-time All-Ivy selection.

name: David Lee
bio: David brings energy and physicality to the front row. He also serves as a reserve lineout caller.
